candidates.source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) – Statistiky
candidates.why_relevant: The single most important non-regulator source of Czech card-market statistics: quarterly and annual series (2000-present, plus a historical file back to 1989) covering number and value of cashless transactions at merchants, ATM withdrawals, cashback at retail, e-commerce card transactions, and cards in circulation. Data are aggregated from the card issuers/acquirers themselves (Česká spořitelna, ČSOB, KB, mBank, Raiffeisenbank) and the schemes (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB, Discover), i.e. exactly the granularity individual banks will not release.
candidates.legal_status: publicly published association statistics; reuse likely requires attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled quarterly crawl of the statistics index page; download the per-quarter/per-year PDF and XLS files under the /statistiky/download/ path; parse tables into a time series.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search for card association terms, then direct fetch
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty SBK karty acquiring statistiky

candidates.source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty – O SBK / statut a členská základna
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the card-industry actor landscape in CZ: reportedly ~18 regular members (issuers/acquirers) and ~23 observers (processors, schemes, terminal vendors, service providers). This is the fastest way to build a complete list of every organisation touching cards, POS acquiring and ATM operations in the country.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scrape of the member/observer lists; diff against previous snapshot to detect new entrants and exits in the acquiring/processing market.
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty činnost a členové SBK
candidates.observed_blocker: Fetch of the mirror host www.bankovni-karty.cz failed with 'Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames'. The primary host bankovnikarty.cz fetched fine, so this is a mirror-host TLS issue, not a dead source.

candidates.source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) – Členové
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative roster of ~31-35 banks, building societies and foreign bank branches representing ~99% of the Czech banking sector. Turns one page into a near-complete map of the CZ banking actor landscape (Air Bank, Česká spořitelna, KB, ČSOB group, mBank, MONETA, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit, plus BNP Paribas, Citibank, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, ING branches).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of the member list; cross-reference with the ČNB list of licensed credit institutions to spot non-members.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search + direct fetch of association site
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace statistiky seznam členů banky

candidates.source_name: ČBA Monitor – banking sector and macro indicator portal
candidates.why_relevant: ČBA's dedicated data portal with six recurring indicator families: Ekonomika, Bankovní sektor (assets, employment, profitability, capital adequacy, interest income), Úvěry a vklady (credit/deposit dynamics, NPL ratios, rates), ČBA Hypomonitor (mortgage volumes and rates), Ceny nemovitostí, ČBA Prognóza. Gives association-curated aggregates and commentary, updated monthly/quarterly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of each /kategorie/ page; capture chart data and any downloadable series; Hypomonitor is issued as a monthly press release worth alerting on.
queries_used: cbaonline.cz ČBA analýzy statistiky bezhotovostní platby zpráva

candidates.source_name: ČBA – Průzkumy a indexy ("Češi a platební styk" survey series)
candidates.why_relevant: Recurring ČBA consumer survey on payment behaviour — share of card vs cash use, debit vs credit card penetration, contactless/mobile adoption. Editions found for 2019, 2020, 2021; the series is the association's own demand-side counterpart to SBK's supply-side card volumes and is directly on-topic for cash usage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Site-search cbaonline.cz for 'platební styk' and 'hotovost' annually; archive each edition's page and any attached PDF. Note that the current site navigation does not expose an obvious archive index, so a sitemap/site-search-driven crawl is safer than link-walking.
queries_used: cbaonline.cz ČBA analýzy statistiky bezhotovostní platby zpráva

candidates.why_relevant: Appears in search as ČBA's 'Statistika' entry point but on fetch resolved mainly to a definitional/glossary page rather than a data index. Worth tracking as a possible route into ČBA statistical outputs, but ČBA Monitor is the substantive data home.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency re-check; treat as navigation aid only.
queries_used: cbaonline.cz ČBA analýzy statistiky bezhotovostní platby zpráva

candidates.why_relevant: English-language mirror/parallel presence of ČBA, useful for English terminology, EBF-facing positions and for cross-checking membership counts (~33 banks, ~99% of sector). Also the natural landing page for international-audience publications.

candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly and annual statistics on leasing, non-bank credit and factoring in CZ, with an explicit English-titled quarterly series. Members reportedly cover ~86% of business financing, ~83% of consumer financing and ~95% of factoring, so the aggregates approximate the whole non-bank finance market — the segment ČNB statistics cover least well.

candidates.why_relevant: Directory of ~34 specialised finance companies (leasing, consumer credit, instalment sales, factoring) with a per-company detail page. Enumerates the non-bank lender actor set that does not appear on ČBA's list.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the directory index and each company detail page (observed pattern /spolecnosti/<id>-<slug>); refresh semi-annually and diff.

candidates.why_relevant: Factoring-market statistics of the Asociace factoringových společností ČR, hosted within ČLFA. Members reportedly represent ~95% of the CZ factoring market — a receivables-finance segment adjacent to payments and merchant working capital.

negative_findings.description: ČBA does not expose an obvious top-level statistics/analyses index on cbaonline.cz. https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/analyzy returns 'Stránka nenalezena' (404), and https://www.cbaonline.cz/statistika resolves to what reads as a glossary definition of 'statistika' rather than a data index. The substantive recurring data lives on the separate cbamonitor.cz property, and survey/report pages sit at flat slugs (e.g. /cesi-a-platebni-styk-2021) reachable mainly via search.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single ČBA publications archive URL identified; collection must go via cbamonitor.cz plus sitemap/site-search-driven discovery on cbaonline.cz.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A link-walking crawler pointed at cbaonline.cz will silently miss the survey series; the collector needs a search- or sitemap-driven strategy and should not conclude the reports do not exist.

negative_findings.description: The ČBA 'Češi a platební styk' payment-behaviour survey was found for 2019, 2020 and 2021 only. Searches did not surface 2022-2026 editions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Series may have been discontinued, renamed, or moved behind a different slug pattern; not confirmed either way.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If discontinued, the demand-side cash-vs-card view for CZ must be sourced elsewhere (ČNB, ECB SPACE study, APEK). Treat as an open question, not as evidence the series is dead.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'SČS/AKAT'. In Czech financial usage SČS most commonly expands to 'Sdružení českých spotřebitelů' (Czech Consumer Association), which is a consumer body, not a capital-market one; AKAT is 'Asociace pro kapitálový trh ČR'. Searching SČS together with card/acquiring terms returned no card-market association by that acronym — it instead surfaced SBK (Sdružení pro bankovní karty), which is the genuine card body.
negative_findings.result_summary: SČS treated as a probable brief-side conflation; AKAT covered fully, and SBK added as the card-sector body the brief appears to have been reaching for.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream collector from chasing a non-existent 'SČS' payments association, and flags that SBK — arguably the single highest-value source in this cell — was not named in the brief at all.

negative_findings.description: https://www.clfa.cz/spolecnosti and https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/analyzy both returned 404s on fetch. In the ČLFA case the site's own navigation points to /o-nas/clenske-spolecnosti as the real directory, and individual company pages under /spolecnosti/<id>-<slug> do resolve in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are path-guess misses, not dead sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Records these URLs as wrong-path hypotheses so a later verification pass does not mark ČLFA's member directory as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Fintech Association member grid at czechfintech.cz/en/clenove/ renders only a handful of logos in static HTML behind a 'Zobrazit dalších více jak 80 členů' expander.
negative_findings.result_summary: Full 80+ member roster not obtainable by plain HTTP fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most complete CZ fintech/PSP actor enumeration requires headless rendering or the underlying data feed; a static crawler would report ~5 members and badly understate the ecosystem.

negative_findings.description: No Czech trade association dedicated specifically to ATM operating/deployment (independent ATM deployers) or to POS terminal estate was found. ATM and POS terminal counts appear only as metrics inside SBK's card statistics, and terminal/POS vendors appear only as ordinary members inside the Czech Fintech Association and SBK's observer list.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS infrastructure has no standalone CZ trade body in this cell's coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms SBK is the only association-level route to ATM/POS estate data in CZ; anything more granular must come from the regulator (ČNB) or commercial sources, which are outside this cell.

negative_findings.description: ASPPS (Asociace poskytovatelů platebních služeb ČR, aspps.eu, IČO 04387783) surfaced only via a registry mirror and a bare http URL; no statistics or member list was observed, and its activity level could not be established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with low credibility/confidence rather than dropped, because it is the only body found that is specifically a PSP association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If active, it would fill the one structural gap in this cell — non-bank payment institutions have no other association home. Warrants a manual check before investing collection effort.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was found representing merchant acquirers or payment-terminal operators as a distinct group, and none representing independent ATM deployers. SBK's observer list is the closest proxy but its composition was not directly verified in this pass (the mirror host failed TLS).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.bankovnikarty.cz/pages/czech/o_sbk_statut.html and the činnost page directly on the bankovnikarty.cz host (which fetched successfully) to extract the observer list; cross-reference against the ČNB register of payment institutions to identify acquirers with no association home.

coverage_gaps.description: SBK claims card statistics from 2000 to 2026 plus a historical Excel from 1989, but the exact download URL pattern under /statistiky/download/ was inferred from relative paths rather than confirmed file-by-file.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a directory/index enumeration pass over the SBK statistics download area to pin the exact filename convention (sbk_statistika_<period>_<year>.pdf/xls) and build a complete back-catalogue manifest before starting incremental collection.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association output is thin: only czech-ba.cz/en, apek.cz/en and ČLFA's English-titled quarterly results page were found. SBK, AKAT, APNÚ, AČSS and the fintech association publish substantively in Czech only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Czech-language extraction and translation in the collection pipeline for this cell; do not scope an English-only collector. Maintain the CS glossary (statistiky, členové/členské společnosti, zveřejněná data, tisková zpráva, bezhotovostní platby, dobírka, výběry z bankomatů, objem financování) as the crawl vocabulary.

coverage_gaps.description: APEK's annual E-commerce Study — the richest association source on e-commerce payment mix and cash-on-delivery decline — is free to members and presumably paid otherwise. Only press-release-level figures are openly available. APNÚ's new credit register is likewise presumably members-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide whether to acquire the APEK study through legitimate purchase/membership rather than scraping; in the interim collect the free /clanky payment-method releases and data.apek.cz as a lower-resolution substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: Several adjacent CZ bodies were not searched in this pass for time reasons: Česká asociace pojišťoven (insurance, for bancassurance/insurtech overlap), Asociace družstevních záložen / kampeliček (credit unions), any CZ crypto-asset industry association (relevant post-MiCA for payments), and Hospodářská komora ČR sectoral sections.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'Česká asociace pojišťoven statistiky', 'družstevní záložny asociace', 'asociace kryptoměn ČR', and 'Hospodářská komora finanční sekce' to close the association map.

coverage_gaps.description: AČSS explicitly states its statistics derive from the Ministry of Finance, and several association aggregates may similarly re-publish ČNB or ministry data with association framing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each association series, record provenance explicitly (association-collected from members vs. re-published official data) so downstream analysis does not treat a re-publication as an independent corroborating source.

brief: The Czech trade-body layer is unusually productive for payments intelligence: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) publishes quarterly and annual card statistics back to 2000 — merchant transactions, ATM withdrawals, cashback, e-commerce volumes and cards in issue, aggregated directly from issuers and schemes — making it the single highest-value source in this cell and the only association-level route to ATM/POS estate figures in CZ. Alongside it, ČBA supplies the banking actor map (~31-35 members, ~99% of the sector) plus a genuine data portal at cbamonitor.cz, while ČLFA, AKAT and AČSS each own their sub-sector's aggregate statistics (non-bank credit and factoring, assets under management, building savings) with member directories that collectively enumerate nearly every regulated financial actor in the country; the Czech Fintech Association's 80+ member grid adds the fintech, PSP and terminal-vendor tail, and APEK contributes the e-commerce payment-mix and cash-on-delivery series. The main practical obstacles are structural rather than legal: ČBA has no coherent publications index (its survey series is only reachable by search), the fintech member list is JavaScript-gated, APEK's flagship study is paywalled, and several association series are re-publications of Ministry of Finance or ČNB data that must be provenance-tagged rather than counted as independent corroboration. Everything worth collecting here is Czech-language, so an English-only collector would capture almost none of it.
